notes: Multi-Browser Support: Aure Homepage is now officially available for Mozilla Firefox in addition to Google Chrome.
Real-Time Cross-Tab Sync: All settings, layouts, wallpapers, and widgets now sync instantly across all open tabs without refreshing.
Live IP & Network Checker: View your public IP address, location, country flag, and connection quality right from the Network Status widget.
Privacy Controls: New Privacy settings tab to customize IP checking or hide location details.
Bookmarks Experience: Cleaned up and renamed Sites & Folders to Bookmarks in Settings for a more natural, familiar experience.
Enhanced Reliability: Optimized background timer alarms and instant browser focus on notification clicks.
Smarter Search: Prevented search suggestions from unexpectedly reappearing when returning to open tabs.
Smoother Performance: Faster startup, lower memory footprint, and standardized date and time formatting throughout all widgets.
